prompt:
Create one clean animation spritesheet for Tinh Linh Nang Am Stage 1.
Use the attached front-facing MASTER render as the strict identity source.

Character identity: cute chibi warm forest deer spirit pet, front-facing, green body with cream face and belly, warm green-gold eyes, soft blush cheeks, leafy ears, small golden branch antlers, gentle leaf accents, small paws, warm glowing chest charm or heart mark, cozy forest sunlight palette, rounded baby deer spirit silhouette.

Important identity rules: Preserve the green body, cream face and belly, leafy ears, small branch antlers, warm green-gold eyes, chest charm or heart mark, small paws, cozy forest sunlight identity. Do not remove antlers, do not add crescent moon crest, do not turn it into the sprout form, bird form, or moon fox form. No accessories beyond the original chest charm. Preserve exact proportions, colors, eyes, face, chest mark, silhouette, and soft chibi style from the attached image. Keep mostly front-facing unless a state needs slight head or eye direction. Do not redesign, do not change species, do not crop, no external decorations.

Output format: one single transparent PNG spritesheet, 6 animation rows x 9 columns, total 54 frames. Each row is one animation state. Same size cells. Each frame centered with consistent padding. Transparent background only, real alpha transparency. No text labels, row names, frame numbers, contact sheet labels, checkerboard, or background.

Global production rules: cute mobile virtual pet animation, cozy fantasy pet, soft chibi game asset, readable at 128px, consistent identity across all cells, consistent scale and registration. Registration stability is more important than dramatic motion. Smooth source-frame motion, no near-duplicate repeated holds. No external effects, no props, no food objects.

Row order left to right:
ROW 1 Idle, 9 frames: neutral eyes open; blink begins; blink closed; eyes open calm; tiny natural leaf accents, antlers, and small body/tail follow-through motion; second tiny motion; soft breath down; soft breath up; loop-compatible neutral.
ROW 2 Happy, 9 frames: gentle smile; smile grows; eyes brighter by expression only; tiny side arms or body lift; cheerful peak; leaf accents, antlers, and small body/tail follow-through follow-through; settle lively; relaxed happy; loop-compatible happy.
ROW 3 Sad, 9 frames: slightly sad eyes; clear sad expression; appendages droop; body sinks; appendages fold closer; soft sad breath; low resting pose; sad hold; loop-compatible sad.
ROW 4 Sleep, 9 frames: sleepy open; eyelids lower; head dips; body sinks; appendages relax inward; almost asleep; eyes fully closed; calm sleep hold; loop-compatible sleep. No Z symbols or bubbles.
ROW 5 Excited, 9 frames: excited neutral; anticipation; squash; small jump starts; small jump peak; air follow-through; soft landing; recover; loop-compatible excited. Keep jump tiny and safe inside canvas.
ROW 6 Hungry, 9 frames: hungry neutral; mouth opens; tiny cute drool appears; head and eyes look upper-left around 11 o'clock; hold upper-left; return center with cute drool; tiny hungry breath; head and eyes look lower-right around 5 o'clock; loop-compatible hungry. No food, drool small and adorable.

Style: same as master render, cozy mobile game animation source frames, soft hand-painted chibi fantasy, clean readable silhouette, no harsh neon, no realism, no pixel art, no heavy black outlines.
